title: Prevalence of undernourishment in the world, 2001–2025
description: Bar chart of the share of the world's population estimated to be undernourished, every second year: 2001, 13.0 percent; 2003, 12.9; 2005, 12.1; 2007, 10.0; 2009, 9.0; 2011, 8.2; 2013, 7.7; 2015, 8.0; 2017, 7.2; 2019, 7.5; 2021, 8.6; 2023, 8.5; 2025, 7.8 (a nowcast). Data: FAOSTAT Suite of Food Security Indicators, annual values, as revised for The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2026.
